timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 57-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.81, creatinine 0.74, hemoglobin 13.9, platelets 276, sodium 139, wbc 6.7; vitals dbp 72-76, heart_rate 75-80, map 91-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 130-135, spo2 97-99, temp 36.5-36.7
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.72, hemoglobin 14.1, platelets 266, sodium 138, wbc 7.1; vitals dbp 72-77, heart_rate 76-80, map 92-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 131-133, spo2 97-99, temp 36.5-36.8
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 57-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
